gates.reason: The runner image uses the mutable `latest` tag, leaving CI execution dependent on whichever image the registry currently serves.
This Helm values file defines runner deployment settings, not detector, parser, calculation, recommendation, or validated-fix content.
Runner capacity is explicitly bounded (`minRunners: 2`, `maxRunners: 12`); no unbounded scaling or hot-path computation is introduced.

findings.title: CI runner image is not pinned to an immutable digest
findings.what: The scale set executes `chd-ci-runner:latest`. Because that tag can be moved, a registry update or compromise can change the code and tools executed by privileged CI workflows without any corresponding change to this audited configuration.
findings.fix: Replace `:latest` with an approved immutable digest, for example `chd-ci-runner@sha256:<verified-digest>`, and update that digest through the reviewed image-release process.
findings.acceptance: Render the Helm release and verify the runner container image contains an approved `@sha256:` digest and no mutable tag; start a runner pod and confirm its resolved `imageID` matches that digest.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial second pass re-read deploy/arc/runner-scale-set-values.yaml:38-50 at baseline c8b98a29508b5eb7725c75a7e2a41dfa94c1feba. Line 42 still specifies the mutable `latest` tag; the nearby restricted security context mitigates container privilege escalation but does not provide image immutability.
